response.description: Align Microsoft Marketplace purchases to your business's accounting needs. Purchase order mapping helps allocate your Microsoft invoice, including Marketplace purchases, making it easier to reconcile your organization's cloud and AI spend. Get supplemental invoice views by purchase order and remap spend for up to three months after invoicing, so your teams get the flexibility to adapt as your needs evolve.Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Purchase order mapping available in Microsoft Marketplace
